import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
            String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
            if (parts.length < 2) continue;
            int n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            int k = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            double[] p = new double[n];
            String[] pStr = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                p[i] = Double.parseDouble(pStr[i]);
            }

            int size = 1 << n;
            double[] sum = new double[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (((i >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                        sum[i] += p[j];
                    }
                }
            }

            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (p[i] > 1e-5) cnt++;
            }

            if (cnt <= k) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    double pp = p[i] > 1e-5 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
                    out.print(pp);
                    if (i + 1 != n) out.print(" ");
                }
                out.println();
                continue;
            }

            double[] dp = new double[size];
            dp[0] = 1.0;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < size; mask++) {
                int rmask = (~mask) & (size - 1);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((rmask >> i) & 1) != 0 && p[i] > 1e-5) {
                        int newMask = mask | (1 << i);
                        if (sum[rmask] > 1e-15) {
                            dp[newMask] += dp[mask] * p[i] / sum[rmask];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            double[] ans = new double[n];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < size; mask++) {
                int countBits = Integer.bitCount(mask);
                if (countBits != k) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                        ans[i] += dp[mask];
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                out.print(ans[i]);
                if (i + 1 != n) out.print(" ");
            }
            out.println();
        }
        out.flush();
    }
}
